hejaz.title: Flag of the Kingdom of Hejaz
desc: - The Kingdom of Hejaz (1916–1925) flag was the original Arab Revolt flag — the direct ancestor of the Pan-Arab flag and the flags of Jordan, Palestine, and others
- **Construction:** three horizontal bands of black (top), green (middle), and white (bottom), with a red triangle on the hoist — the original Arab Revolt flag design
trivia:
- The Kingdom of Hejaz (1916–1925) was an early Arab state in the Arabian Peninsula
- Briefly independent during the Arab Revolt against Ottoman rule
- Conquered by Saudi Arabia and incorporated into the modern kingdom

hatay.title: Flag of the Republic of Hatay
desc:
- The flag of the Republic of Hatay (1938–1939) featured a red field with a white horizontal stripe and a red star and crescent on the white band
- Hatay was a short-lived state in what is now southern Turkey's Hatay Province, which joined Turkey in 1939 after a controversial referendum
- The flag design reflected both Turkish influence and the desire for independent identity
- **Construction:** a red field with a horizontal white stripe centred. A red star and crescent on the white band. Ratio approximately 2:3
trivia:
- Hatay was a disputed territory between Turkey and Syria (1938–1939)
- Awarded to Turkey after French mandate authority allowed a plebiscite
- Syria still claims Hatay as part of its territory

desc:
- The flag of the Arab Federation (1958) was a horizontal triband of black, white, and green with a red triangle at the hoist — the Pan-Arab colours representing the Abbasid, Umayyad, Fatimid, and Hashemite dynasties
- The Arab Federation was a brief union of Iraq and Jordan formed in February 1958 as a counterweight to the United Arab Republic (Egypt–Syria)
- It lasted only five months before being dissolved by the Iraqi revolution of July 1958
- **Construction:** three equal horizontal stripes of black (top), white, and green, with a red isosceles triangle at the hoist
- A white seven-pointed star sat within the triangle
- Ratio 1:2

countryData.name: Arab Federation
countryData.officialName: Arab Federation of Iraq and Jordan

trivia: - The Arab Federation lasted only 5 months (Feb–Jul 1958), making it one of the shortest-lived political unions in modern history
- It was created as a direct response to Egypt and Syria forming the United Arab Republic
